title: Epistle paragraph lab
subtitle: Turn a dense sentence into an evidence-based map.
overview: This lab combines the A2 Core method: find the assertion, bracket its clauses, attach participles, and make relational notes for cases and prepositions.
A good answer can preserve an ambiguity. It must show why the words were attached as they were.

items.grc: αὐτὸς γὰρ ἡ εἰρήνη ἡμῶν, ὁ ποιήσας τὰ ἀμφότερα ἓν.
items.en: For he himself is our peace, the one who made the two one.

items.grc: ἵνα τοὺς δύο κτίσῃ ἐν ἑαυτῷ εἰς ἕνα καινὸν ἄνθρωπον.
items.en: So that he might create the two in himself into one new humanity.
